name: OpenClaw
note: Sessions are JSONL transcripts under ~/.openclaw/agents/<agent>/sessions, one file per conversation, with a session record carrying the working directory and a message record per turn carrying its own usage. Tokens come from that accounting rather than from counting characters. Cost is deliberately not mapped: OpenClaw runs local models through providers like mlx, whose rates are not in the pricing table, and a cost derived from a rate we do not have would be a number rather than a fact. The workspace is the session's working directory, so the bootstrap files are found where the probe already looks and no environment variable has to be read: AGENTS.md holds the operating instructions and SOUL.md the persona, both loaded every session. Memory is MEMORY.md when curated and the memory/ folder of daily logs otherwise; the curated file is declared first because it is the one a person wrote. Workspace skills live in skills/, ahead of the managed ones under ~/.openclaw/skills. That last path is the only one a profile moves — OPENCLAW_PROFILE relocates ~/.openclaw, which a descriptor cannot see — and it reads as absent rather than wrong.

compatibility.note: Read from the agent's own JSONL transcripts; validate against a local install with --check.
